rag.text:
Test: TC-609 — Feature area - Task Scheduling - Dependencies - Links scheduling in Gantt module when ASAP mode is turned on
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-79 Feature area - Task Scheduling - Dependencies
Labels: teamscheduling

Steps:
1. Navigate to plugin's Technical Configuration -> General/Link tab and turn on ASAP mode
   Expected: ASAP mode is turned on
2. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-271 / TC-609 Links scheduling in Gantt module when ASAP mode is turned on/off
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed
3. Move Timeline to date
   Data: date: 25/Sep/20
   Expected: Timeline is moved to selected date
4. Click on endpoint on the the right side of taskbar and drag the cursor to the start of targetTask
   Data: taskbar: TC-609 Analysis
targetTask: TC-609 Final feature
   Expected: Tasks are linked. Target task is moved and starts on 21/Oct/20, so that there is no gap time between the source and the target tasks
5. Click on link started from taskbar and check if ASAP mode is turned on
   Data: taskbar: TC-609 Analysis
   Expected: ASAP mode is turned on
6. Move the taskbar to the date
   Data: taskbar: TC-609 Final feature
date: 06/Oct/20
   Expected: Target task cannot be moved to the past. Task is moved back to 21/Oct/20, so that there is no gap time between the source and the target tasks

FolLowing message appears:

Unable to change dates

The dates of this task are determined by the dependency linking it to another task. Linked task: TC-609 Analysis
7. Move the taskbar to the date
   Data: taskbar: TC-609 Final feature
date: 20/Nov/20
   Expected: Target task cannot be moved to the future. Task is moved back to 21/Oct/20, so that there is no gap time between the source and the target task

FolLowing message appears:
Unable to change dates

The dates of this task are determined by the dependency linking it to another task. Linked task: TC-609 Analysis
8. Resize the taskbar to the date
   Data: taskbar: TC-609 Final feature
date: 7/Oct/20
   Expected: Task is resized, start date isn't changed but new end date is 17/Nov/20. 

FolLowing message appears:

Dates adjusted by dependency

The dates of this task are determined by the dependency linking it to another task. Linked task: TC-609 Analysis
9. Click on link started from taskbar and add lagTime
   Data: taskbar: TC-609 Analysis
lagTime: 5
   Expected: Target task "TC-609 Final feature" is moved to 20/Nov/20, so that it starts as soon as possible, considering setted lag time
